creativeThesis: A blocked possibility makes a formerly dark outcome possible.
viewerExperience: One photon, two possible routes, a visibly zero dark-output contribution; blocker, absorption, separate click, paradox, then before/after cancellation and honest trial qualification.
emotionalTarget: Prediction conflict followed by precise understanding, with risk and practical limits retained.
visualThesis: Progressively reveal alternatives; leave the apparatus to enlarge cancellation, separate trial events, then expand the successful detector into a two-fact visual climax.

decisions.treatment: Progressive spatial path construction with moving amplitude ribbons; full-field cancellation demonstration; enlarged separate absorption and detection events; paired obstacle-detected/nonabsorbed-photon climax. No fixed optical bench, equipment jargon or simulated measured trajectory.
decisions.rationale: Teach one causal relationship at a time; preserve path identity but change scale and composition as attention moves.
alternativesConsidered: Keep the full fixed apparatus and improve labels, colors and pulse speed.
Human-scale maze or railway analogy replacing quantum apparatus.
Progressively constructed possibilities and enlarged cancellation, with separate event stages.

decisions.treatment: Deep ink field, cyan/amber alternatives and warm absorber; dark output becomes a luminous event. No metal bench or serial equipment labels.
decisions.rationale: A dark surface makes the unlit detector baseline and later lit outcome observable. This is an outcome-contrast choice, not color rotation after Sealed Scroll or a science style.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro af_heart at 0.97; connected complete sentences, calm curiosity, deliberate failed-trial boundary.
decisions.rationale: Current voice identity; no quantum-mysticism tone or typography-defined audio generation.

decisions.treatment: Manrope48px/600 ivory, natural speech phrases in a quiet lower reading region; four-frame opacity, fixed glyphs.
decisions.rationale: Captions preserve conditions and reasoning while instrument state remains visible. This placement is intentional readability continuity, not claimed visual novelty.

decisions.treatment: Voice and silence; no music or fabricated photon/detector sound.
decisions.rationale: The signal is an illustrative visual, not a recorded laboratory event; speech carries causal reasoning without a faux instrument recording.

decisions.treatment: Connected plain-language narration; no initial equipment vocabulary. Event-scale transitions and brief causal holds; measured runtime rather than duration target.
decisions.rationale: Register open baseline, cancellation and distinct trial outcomes. No duration threshold or padding.

decisions.treatment: Single source photon and unlit detector separated by an unexplained obstacle. Reveal route relationships progressively after question.
decisions.rationale: The hook names an operational puzzle; no bomb, exaggerated application or universal harmless promise.

decisions.treatment: 1080×1920/30fps with inset-aware source, paths, outputs, captions and disclosures; four separately bound provisional profiles.
decisions.rationale: Actual-media sampled preflight preserves native/device/crop unknowns.

risks: Amplitude curves are not divided photon energy or measured trajectories.
Absorption and successful detection must be different trials.
Ideal alignment is not a claim of noiseless experimental certainty.
Interaction-free is scoped to no absorption/scattering in the detected trial, not every interpretation zero interaction.

provenance.notes: Session revised from exact owner comprehension feedback. Actual recent approved-master sheets re-viewed; historical direction records read; original prior IFM sheet also viewed. No discovery or owner master approval.
